aboutGame.title: What is Makeup Mania?
paragraphs: Makeup Mania is a Roblox makeup-artist simulation. Each session hands you a client with a short brief, and your job is to build a look that matches what they asked for using the tools on your palette. There is no combat and no way to permanently fail, so you can experiment freely while you learn how the game scores your work.

Progress comes from coins and star ratings. High-scoring looks unlock new products, clients, and styling options, and the habits that earn three stars early, such as reading the brief, prepping the base, and blending in thin layers, carry straight into later and harder requests. Our wiki collects beginner guides, tool breakdowns, and scoring tips in one place.

modules.name: Makeup Mania Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of the core loop: reading the client brief, prepping the base, building the focal point, blending, submitting, and reading your score.

highlights.detail: Read the client brief and note the occasion, mood, and any specific request before picking products.
Prep the base with skin products first, since everything layered on top inherits that undertone.
Build the focal point by nailing the one feature the client emphasized most.
Blend supporting color so cheeks, lips, and eyes read as one harmonious story.
Finish and submit after cleaning up the edges and checking the perimeter.
Review the score breakdown to see which category cost you stars before the next client.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Makeup Mania.

items.question: What is Makeup Mania?
items.answer: Makeup Mania is a free-to-play Roblox makeup-artist simulation. You receive a client, read the brief, apply products from a tool palette, and submit the finished look for a star rating. There is no combat and no way to permanently fail, so new players can experiment freely.

items.question: Is Makeup Mania free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Makeup Mania is free to play on Roblox, and every product category can be unlocked through normal play. Optional passes add cosmetics and convenience but are not required to score well.

items.question: How do I score three stars in Makeup Mania?
items.answer: Match the brief first, then prep the base, build the one feature the client emphasized, blend supporting color, and submit with time to spare. Reading the score breakdown after each look is the fastest way to find the category costing you stars.

items.question: Where do I find Makeup Mania codes?
items.answer: Makeup Mania codes are posted with update and milestone announcements, then entered in the in-game promo or gift panel. Redeem them as soon as you find them, since most expire quickly and only work once per account.

items.question: What tools do I need in Makeup Mania?
items.answer: Start with the base products, then eyeshadow, brows, liner, lashes, blush, and highlighter. Foundation sets the undertone that every later layer inherits, so it has the largest effect on your final score.
